title: Live character creator on the Mio and Eric bases
question: Is this base good enough to build new characters on?

options.label: base-ok
options.note: Build new characters on it. Your fixes from creator-base-5: the hair paint is gone from both bare heads (the base has its own clean skin texture); Eric's bare head now sits on a neck that goes up into it; idle is the approved relaxed idle; eyes have four shapes (original plus round, sharp, sleepy) and seven colours; four hair styles (short crop, bob, ponytail, spiky), four tops, four bottoms and two kinds of shoes, all made from the body itself so each one fits both bodies. Mio's and Eric's own hair and clothes are still there and fit only their own body.

options.label: needs-work
options.note: Tell me what to fix first. What I can still see: sleeve and trouser ends are open tubes, so you can look inside a cuff close up; a swinging hand passes through a skirt; the drawn eyes are flat and don't have the painted eyes' shading; Mio's big ears show with short hair (a bob tucks them in); Eric's stubble layer only shows with his own hair, because it also holds bits of his side hair.
